caption: The drawing depicts an octagonal tray with a wide decorative border and a plain central area. The border features a colorful floral pattern with swirls and rounds in red, green, yellow, orange, and cream colors, as well as assorted green leaves. The outermost edge of the border is dark purple or brown with a zigzag yellow line running through it. The interior flat area of the tray is grayish with brownish and orange irregular patches. The background of the image is an off-white color, and there is a rectangular patch of light tan color in the upper left corner outside the tray.
title: Tray
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
